name: Prismecs dry-sump turbine lubrication system (external reservoir, AC auxiliary / DC emergency pumps, duplex filters, coolers)
description: lube oil system package for rotating plant

specifications.basis: Prismecs article 'Gas Turbine Lubrication Systems...', published 11 February 2024; article states API 614 6th ed February 2022 governs design.
Prismecs article, 'Oil Specification: Grade and Type'; published 11 February 2024. Grades 68 and 77 used where OEM specifies higher viscosity.

specifications.metric: oil cleanliness target, typical OEM range
specifications.basis: Prismecs article, 'Cleanliness: The ISO 4406 Target'; published 11 February 2024; states most turbine OEMs target between these codes. (low: 15/13/10) (high: 17/15/12)

specifications.metric: new oil cleanliness, published OEM tables
specifications.basis: Prismecs article, 'What OEMs actually specify'; published 11 February 2024; some specifications set minimum 20/17/14 (conflicting values preserved).
Prismecs article: 'Some OEMs additionally require that oil be filtered through a 10 micron filter before entering service'; published 11 February 2024.
Prismecs article, 'Varnish: The Modern Problem'; published 11 February 2024.

specifications.unit: % of manufacturer's rating (printed: 'not greater than 90 percent')
specifications.basis: Prismecs article citing API 614 sixth edition pump sizing; published 11 February 2024.
"API Standard 614, Sixth Edition, February 2022 governs its design in petroleum, chemical and gas service"
"ISO grades 32, 46 and 68 are the products of interest in the turbine industry, with grades 46, 68 or 77 used where the turbine manufacturer specifies higher viscosity"
"ISO 8068 governs turbine oil specification, alongside the turbine OEM's own requirements"
"most turbine OEMs target between ISO 15/13/10 and ISO 17/15/12"
"new oil specified at ISO 4406 16/14/12 for both ISO VG 32 and ISO VG 46 on several industrial gas turbine platforms, with some specifications setting a minimum standard of 20/17/14"
"ISO 4406 defines cleanliness codes based on particle counts per millilitre at 4, 6 and 14 microns"
"Some OEMs additionally require that oil be filtered through a 10 micron filter before entering service"

specifications.metric: Rotary screw pump differential pressure limit
specifications.basis: "Rotary screw pumps must be sized so that the pressure differential through the pump is not greater than 90 percent of the manufacturer's rating at rated capacity and minimum viscosity"
Table: "Viscosity at 40°C ... Commonly minus 10 to plus 25 percent against new oil"
"Membrane patch colorimetry (MPC), ASTM D7843, is the standard test"
"IOGP S-744 is a supplementary specification to API 614 Sixth Edition"
Blog post dated February 11, 2024 (25 minutes read)

notes: Product/catalogue record from a page read in the GEG plant WBS sweep. Full-parameter pass 2026-11-26: 12 new printed parameters.
